selectedProject.name: Hermes Agentic Workflow
selectedProject.nextAction: Define the first safe agentic execution loop: plan, patch, test, report, and require approval before merge.

objective: Generate a source-code patch proposal without applying source changes, pushing, or merging.

disallowedTargets: package-lock.json unless dependency changes are explicitly approved

targetFiles.reason: Document the next safe transition from artifact-only patch apply to source patch proposal.
Store the proposed source patch contract as a durable Hermes artifact.

proposedChanges.summary: Add Source Patch Proposal v1 section describing proposal-only behavior, required approval, checks, and rollback notes.
proposedChanges.expectedOutcome: The agentic workflow documentation explains how Hermes proposes source changes safely before applying them.

proposedChanges.summary: Create durable source patch proposal contract for future apply step.
proposedChanges.expectedOutcome: Future source patch apply workflow can read a structured proposal artifact.

rollbackNotes: Do not apply source changes if proposal target files fall outside allowed prefixes.
Delete generated source patch proposal artifacts if proposal is rejected.
Restore docs/hermes-agentic-workflow.md before commit if documentation change is not approved.
notes: This is the first Hermes source patch proposal.
It does not apply source changes.
It prepares the contract needed for a later constrained source patch apply workflow.
